operator-walkthrough.ref: Q-23 phase 7 (2026-10-01, branch nickstire/q23-phase7-provenance). What the operator sees on Admin > Intelligence HQ: (1) AI Health & Opportunities. The Health Score now wears a tag under its label: ESTIMATE when the score is reliable, because it is a weighted composite of heuristics, and UNMEASURED when a third or more of the engines failed (the score already shows a dash then). The score itself changes in one case: when the churn, repeat-visit or lead-response engine's database read failed, that engine used to score as the best case (a failed churn read added +8 for '0 high-risk customers'). It is now left out of the score, counted in 'N of 28 intelligence engines failed', and named under Engine Failures, e.g. 'churn prediction: its read failed'. The panel status chip reads 'partial' in that case instead of 'live'. (2) AI usage by lane. Calls, failed % and tokens each wear a tag: MEASURED while the ledger records; ESTIMATE while recording is off or stopped (calls in the window may be missing) and for tokens when some calls returned no usage; an empty window is MEASURED only while recording, UNMEASURED otherwise; an unreadable ledger is UNMEASURED. (3) Customer Intelligence: no visible change; a test now pins the 'Due Or Overdue' label. Proof is jsdom renders with mocked reports and a mocked engine set, not a live admin session: masterIntelligenceReadFailed.test.ts 5/5 (4/5 red on main; the control passes on both), ai-health-llm-provenance.test.tsx 8/8 (8/8 red against main's panels), customer-intelligence-provenance.test.tsx 7/7 (the new label case red when the label is renamed back). Not yet seen by the operator on the installed PWA.
